title: Light Chinese Shirataki Yangzhou Fried Rice
description: A citrusy and fluffy Chinese dish featuring shirataki noodles, whole30-friendly and made in the style of Yangzhou fried rice. This recipe is a light and refreshing take on traditional fried rice.
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add scallions and cook for 2 minutes, until they start to soften.
Push scallions to one side of the pan, then add a little more coconut oil if necessary.
Add shirataki noodles to the other side of the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes, until they start to brown.
Mix everything together, then add salt, pepper, and orange zest.
Push the noodle mixture to one side of the pan, then add a little more coconut oil if necessary.
Add large eggs to the other side of the pan and scramble them until cooked through.
Mix everything together, then add orange juice and sesame oil.
Stir-fry everything together for 1-2 minutes, until the liquid is absorbed and the noodles are well coated.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
